law: CLAUDE.md Rule 24 as widened (all schema enumeration) and scoped (outcome arrays; CE against the declared layer) 2026-08-20
declared_layer: per-(unresolved census row) integration disposition -- how one ATOM_LAYER0_RESOLUTION_CENSUS_20260820 row with resolution_state UNRESOLVED closes through the atom_layer0 framework
note_on_starting_taxonomy: The founding direction's parenthetical (decomposes / atomic-but-unbound / finding-routed-to-owner) flattens three intents on one axis: concept-composition verdict, binding state, and the routing act (which is true of EVERY census row by census law -- 'every row routes'). Retained only as the derived display mapping after splitting, mirroring ~B's precedent correction of their own starting taxonomy.

census_currency.intent: whether the row's recorded defect is still live at HEAD (the base-CRO-mandated vintage-drift guard verdict, msg 63335)

value_semantics.CURRENT_AT_HEAD: every evidence surface blob-identical between the row's pinned vintage and HEAD; the defect persists as recorded
value_semantics.MOVED_DEFECT_PERSISTS: a surface moved since the pin; direct re-read of HEAD confirms the defect still present
value_semantics.ALREADY_RESOLVED_SINCE_CENSUS: a surface moved since the pin; direct re-read of HEAD shows the recorded defect gone (base-mandated value; never a silent skip, never a stale finding filed as fresh)
value_semantics.SURFACE_RETIRED_AT_HEAD: an evidence surface no longer exists at HEAD; the row needs owner adjudication of successor-vs-abandoned before any act (90-day-dormancy law's successor check, applied at row grain)
value_semantics.GUARD_UNVERIFIABLE: the guard could not read the pinned object; the row's currency is UNKNOWN and is never promoted to any other value

framework_closing_stage.intent: which atom_layer0 stage owns the act that closes the row

value_semantics.S0_NOT_CONCEPT_GRAIN: the row's defect is a self-standing status/progress claim with NO declared-authority binding (record-vs-reality drift); atom_layer0 terminates at S0 -- the census evidence is complete grounds and the owner reconciles + banners
value_semantics.S2_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED: the row cannot close without an atomicity challenge (S1/S2 run) on its concept; scheduled as a framework run
value_semantics.S3_LEGISLATION_GAP: the concept's authority declares no target population/content to resolve against (NO_DECLARED_TARGET_CONTENT class); the closing act is S3-shaped legislation by the owner
value_semantics.S4_BINDING_REPAIR: the row's surface binds (cites / derives from / mirrors / synchronizes with) a DECLARED authority and that binding fails the resolution predicate; the closing act is S4-contract-shaped repair by the owner
value_semantics.INSTRUMENT_GAP: the closing act is blocked on a missing or incapable instrument (NOT_EXERCISABLE / INSTRUMENT_UNKNOWN); instrument status dominates any co-present repairable defect, mirroring the framework's own precedence law

discriminators.s0_vs_s4: measurable per row: does the census evidence name a DECLARED authority the surface binds to (registry entry, rule-bank block, canonical block, manifest declaration)? Present and failing -> S4. Absent (peer-prose or intra-doc status contradiction) -> S0.
discriminators.s3_vs_s4: S3 = no target declared at all; S4 = target declared, binding fails the predicate.
discriminators.instrument_precedence: a row carrying both a repairable defect and an instrument incapacity classifies INSTRUMENT_GAP; the repairable half is listed in the owner act.

postulates.mece: PASS -- exactly one value per row via the three discriminators above
postulates.same_grain: PASS -- one closing act per row
postulates.intent_coherence: PASS -- stage placement of the closing act only; owner and act text live in routing fields, not on this axis
postulates.state_coherence: NAMED PARTIAL FAILURE per Rule 24(iv): the values do NOT move under one remedy -- S0/S4 close by owner edits, S3 by a legislation act, S2 by a framework run, INSTRUMENT_GAP by a tool build. This is the axis's PURPOSE (it partitions remedies), stated here so the frame is explicit: one remedy does not move all values, by design.

S2's zero is a finding in itself: the census's unresolved set contains no atomicity failure -- it is binding/legislation/instrument/status repair.

atomicity_certificate.intent: whether a bounded ATOMIC_WITHIN certificate exists for the row's concept at a matching grammar and scope

value_semantics.EXISTS: a validated atom_layer0 run holds ATOMIC_WITHIN(grammar@version x scope) covering the row's concept at the row's scope
value_semantics.NONE: concept-grain subject, no certificate at any matching scope
value_semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: S0_NOT_CONCEPT_GRAIN subjects -- no concept whose atomicity could be certificated

postulates.state_coherence: PASS -- moves only on a new validated run or a grammar-version invalidation
postulates.collective_exhaustion_vs_layer: PASS -- exists / absent / inapplicable is total over the layer

workstream_grouping_note: The roadmap's workstreams are a DELIVERY grouping (one owner act closing N rows), not a classification axis: intent = one dispatchable unit of owner work; grain = one owner x one mechanism; every row maps to exactly one primary workstream (cross-links recorded where one act also discharges another row's sub-part). Declared here per the widened law because grouping is an enumeration act.
